expectation: the gate holds back much of Ibadan; coverage falls but stays above 0.20 and false merges stay in bound. Control alone may fail in Oyo as it did in Lagos
known_risks: shared source ids are shown to the reviewer
GATE_N was chosen on development labels that include Lagos, the case it was designed for; Oyo is its first independent test
the FCT label on Joefag Alheri Clinic and Maternity (its own twin, marked different) is kept as exported in development
the crowd count includes HFR duplicates of the facility itself, which inflates n slightly
question: With crowded neighbourhoods held back from auto-matching, does the pair decider keep errors and false merges in bound, and still settle enough pairs, in a dense held-out state (Oyo)?

arms.control: the same combiner without the gate; reported, not tested
arms.gated: the X5 control combiner [cross-encoder logit, log1p km, LGA agree through the alias table, coordinates missing]; a pair whose GRID3 point has more than 15 other HFR facilities within 2 km (HFR national coordinates, the pair's HFR record excluded) is never auto-matched, though it may still be auto-rejected
arms.reference: match-everything, scored under the same rule; it must fail

rule.cross_encoder: X0's recipe with Edo, Kano, Ondo, Lagos, FCT and Oyo held out; weights pinned below
rule.development: 1,310 labelled pairs: X5's development labels with the X4 corrections file, and the FCT pack as exported (no relabel)
rule.error_bound: errors among auto-decided <= 3% and Wilson 95% upper bound <= 10%
rule.false_merge_bound: different pairs auto-matched / all different pairs <= 2% and Wilson 95% upper bound <= 5%
rule.gate: GATE_N = 15, fixed from development out-of-fold predictions before the Oyo pack was built: on 1,310 labels it leaves 1-2 of 6 out-of-fold false merges with X5's models, and out-of-fold coverage about 0.71 against 0.74-0.76 ungated
rule.informative: void unless the test holds at least 60 different pairs
rule.pass: informative, and every seed of the gated arm meets fewer_held, error_bound and false_merge_bound on the whole pack
rule.population: the X6 pack (data/review_packs/nigeria_facilities_oyo_x6_2026-11-22, 250 Oyo pairs: 150 review_band, 50 lookalike, 50 near_miss) marked same_entity or different; read once, after this file
rule.review_band: reported on its own: every seed of the gated arm meets fewer_held and error_bound on the review_band pairs
secondary: development out-of-fold false merges, gated and ungated
rule.thresholds: 5-fold out-of-fold development predictions of the ungated combiner (x3_level.fit); the gate is applied after

test.blind: the reviewer sees neither the engine's decision nor the pair's kind
test.construction: data/scripts/build_x6_pack.py (build_x4_pack.py with STATE = 'Oyo', BAND 150, STRESS 50): 150 of the engine's 342 Oyo review pairs (one per GRID3 facility, salted-hash order), 50 lookalike and 50 near_miss; every row 'review', no score, kind kept out of the pack

why: X5 density features failed in FCT (one false merge on two of three seeds); the control combiner passed. Five of its six development out-of-fold false merges are in Lagos. Oyo is the densest unlabelled state: median other HFR facilities within 2 km of a GRID3 point Lagos 40, Anambra 12, Oyo 11, FCT 3
